name: Unni
overview: Unni was a male Levite who held the position of a second rank Levite and served as a gatekeeper. His role was significant within the tribe of Levi, which was set apart for service to God. The Scriptures mention him specifically in 1 Chronicles 15:18, highlighting his function and tribal affiliation.
namesAndTitles: The name Unni means 'YHWH has answered,' reflecting a theologically rich meaning connected to God's responsiveness. This proper name is recorded in 1 Chronicles 15:18 and is not indicated as being given directly by God.
familyAndRelationships: Unni is explicitly identified as a descendant of Levi, establishing his tribal lineage. Beyond this, Scripture does not record additional family relationships for him.
scriptureSignificance: Unni's importance lies in his role as a gatekeeper among the Levites, serving in a capacity that supported the worship and sacred duties of Israel. His position as a second rank Levite underscores the ordered structure God established for the service of His people. By fulfilling this role, Unni contributed to the proper functioning of the temple ministry during the time recorded in 1 Chronicles.
